description: Original cute top-down enemy jeep with an open cabin and rear-mounted machine gun.

features: four oversized treaded tires with visible hubs
vehicle.orientation: front points to the top edge in forward, fast, shoot, and explosion sheets
vehicle.styleNote: Original colorful tower-defense cartoon; not a reproduction of any named game vehicle.

sheets.notes: Top-down forward travel; rotating treads, gentle suspension bounce and small rear dust puffs.
Faster tread cycle, stronger bounce and larger dust trail; speed marks are crisp, not blurred.
Stationary mounted-gun burst; muzzle flash, ejecting cartridge, small recoil and smoke.
One-shot clockwise 90-degree turn, 0/30/60/90-degree key poses with wheels turning.
Intact jeep, hood fire, comic blast, rising smoke, burning wreck, charcoal remains; hold frame 6.

construct3.import: Import each PNG as a sprite and set animation frame size to 64x64.
construct3.frameOrder: Frames are arranged left-to-right, starting at zero in the image editor.
construct3.oneShot: Turn and explosion are one-shot; hold the last explosion frame.
construct3.wheelBlur: Fast wheels use crisp rotating tread marks and speed dashes, not motion-blurred pixels.
